title_sq: Apartament 2+1 ne shitje te Hipoteka ID: 530181003-448
description_sq:
Apartament 2+1 ne shitje te Hipoteka!
Apartamenti organizohet nga ambient ndenjie e bollshem, me ambientin e gatimi me vete, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet(me dritare), koridori qe ben shperndarjen e dhomave.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e dyte te nje pallati te vitit 2000 pa ashensor dhe shitet pjeserisht i mobiluar.
Zona ku ndodhet ka gjithe facilitetet per nje jetese komode me dalje te shpejte si ne unaze te vogel ashtu dhe ne Rr. Don Bosko.
Apartamenti eshte i pajisur me Certifikate Pronesie.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at Hipoteka ID: 530181003-448
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at Hipoteka! The apartment is organized by a spacious living area, with its own cooking area, two bedrooms, a toilet (with window), the corridor that divides the rooms. The apartment is located on the second floor of a building built in 2000 without an elevator and is sold partially furnished. The area where it is located has all the facilities for a comfortable life with quick access to both the small ring road and Rr. Don Bosco. The apartment is equipped with Ownership Certificate.
